evals.prompt: Create a GitLab issue in the api repo for adding rate-limiting middleware on the /auth/login endpoint. We've had too many brute-force attempts and this is an improvement we want to track. Write a proper description and apply the right label.
evals.expected_output: A glab command sequence that creates an issue in finacode/metalmetre/api with -R flag, writes the description to /tmp first, uses the 'improvement' label, and uses a clear title.
assertions: Uses -R finacode/metalmetre/api (not relying on cwd default)
Writes description body to /tmp/*.md before creating the issue
Issue title is concise and reflects the rate-limiting goal

evals.prompt: I just pushed branch fix/session-ttl to the web repo. Create an MR targeting main and then check whether the pipeline passed.
evals.expected_output: A glab mr create command with conventional-commit title, description from /tmp, -R finacode/metalmetre/web, followed by glab ci status -R finacode/metalmetre/web
assertions: Includes glab ci status check after creating the MR
Description is written to /tmp/mr_body.md or similar before attaching

evals.prompt: The inconsistency issue #42 in flux-config has been resolved — kubectl get deployment -n production now shows the correct replica count of 3. Add evidence and close the issue.
evals.expected_output: A two-step chain: first glab issue note with kubectl evidence, then glab issue close, both targeting finacode/metalmetre/flux-config with -R. Evidence written to /tmp first.
assertions: Writes evidence comment BEFORE closing (not just closing)
Evidence comment includes the kubectl output showing replica count = 3
Close command is chained (&&) after the note command

evals.prompt: The web app is getting CORS errors because the api isn't setting the Access-Control-Allow-Origin header correctly. I need to track this — the fix lives in api, but I want to link it to the existing web issue #15 that users are reporting against.
evals.expected_output: Creates the issue in finacode/metalmetre/api (since api owns the fix), then cross-links from web issue #15 using glab issue note on the web repo. Uses -R on both commands.
assertions: Creates the new issue in finacode/metalmetre/api (not web — api owns the fix)
Cross-links back from web issue #15 using glab issue note -R finacode/metalmetre/web
Cross-link comment references the new api issue ID
